name: application-progress-bars
title: Progress Bars
description: Visual indicators for communicating task completion, upload progress, storage usage, and multi-step workflow advancement.
useWhen: Showing the completion percentage of a file upload, import job, or background task.
Displaying storage or quota usage as a filled bar within a settings or billing panel.
Communicating how far through a multi-step process the user currently is.
avoidWhen: The operation duration is unpredictable — use an indeterminate spinner instead.
Showing just a numeric value is sufficient — a stat block is simpler than a bar.
The progress metric is part of a larger data visualization — use a chart instead.
responsiveBehavior: Progress bars fill their container width at all viewport sizes. Labels and metadata beside the bar reflow or stack on narrow viewports.
accessibility: Use the native <progress> element with value and max attributes for determinate progress.
Add aria-label or an associated <label> to describe what is being measured.
Do not rely on color alone to communicate status — pair color with a visible text label.

variants.title: Basic
variants.description: A single thin progress bar showing percentage completion without labels or decorative elements.
accessibility: Use <progress value="X" max="100"> or role="progressbar" with aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax.

variants.title: With labels and status colors
variants.description: Progress bars with percentage labels and semantic color coding — green for on-track, yellow for warning, red for critical.
accessibility: Color conveys status; pair each color with a visible text label so colorblind users are not excluded.

variants.title: Compact with metadata
variants.description: Slim progress bar with an inline label and numeric value beside it, for dense list or card views.
accessibility: Numeric label beside the bar provides the value to screen readers in addition to the progress element.

variants.title: Circular progress
variants.description: SVG-based circular ring indicator displaying a completion percentage in the center, for dashboards and stat cards.
accessibility: SVG ring is decorative; expose the value via role="progressbar" with aria-valuenow on the container.
